# Explain a Technical Project from Milestone to Production

[← Snowflake](../README.md) · [Every Snowflake question](../../snowflake.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-a-technical-project-from-milestone-to-production)

---

Pick a project with real technical depth. Describe the context, a key milestone, what you personally owned, and the outcome. Then talk through delivery and launch: what went wrong, and how the system performed in production.

### Constraints & Assumptions
Draw from your own project and separate your individual contributions from team-level choices. The question demands both technical depth and the delivery/operations story; an architecture summary by itself won't suffice.

### Clarifying Questions
Why was that milestone significant? What exactly did you own? What diverged from the original plan by launch? How did you assess the live system?

### What a Strong Answer Covers
A crisp objective, one technical decision, proof of the milestone, how launch risks were managed, and a candid result with operational follow-up.

### Follow-up Questions
What broke during delivery? How did you determine the system was ready? What did you watch after launch, and what would you do differently next time?

Overview:
Walk through a technical project from background and ownership, to a major milestone, launch issues, production validation, and lessons learned.
